title: "Always an array" needs normative language
description: §5.1 describes the messages field as 'Always an array' using informal phrasing. This should be rewritten as a normative statement (e.g. 'MUST be an array') consistent with the RFC 2119 language used throughout the rest of the document.
close_reason: Changed 'Always an array' to 'MUST be a non-empty array'
